item.title: A 12TB Steam "teraleak" spills more than a decade of lost PC gaming history

item.title: 20 世纪 60 年代令人震惊的理论：巨石阵是一台史前计算机
item.description:

" Critics of the theory Hawkins concluded that the purpose of Stonehenge was clear. " If this were true, Stonehenge was "a device that priest-rulers could have used to enhance their power", argued a 196.
